verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a SaaS commerce platform, since it could ship an AI assistant or agent interface. The evidence shows only a REST API, webhooks, a no-code store builder and automatic 'intelligent segments', none of which is natural-language command operation. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
